subtopic_title: Identification and properties of angles at a point and angles on a straight line

candidates.proposed_objective_text: Calculate unknown angles on a straight line.
candidates.evidence_quote: The angles must have a sum of $180^{\circ}$, because they form a straight line.
candidates.rationale: The textbook includes a worked example and repeated exercises where learners use the straight-line angle property to compute unknown angle values. That is measurable and more specific than the canonical identify/state AOs.
